task: Redesign The Bayes Group website (apps/bayes-group-site) so it is perceived as a mature, senior engineering and consulting firm: one that designs and builds specific, complex systems, including agentic AI development and multi-system architectures that are built to be observed and to be sustained, while staying approachable for small and medium-sized businesses first, with enterprise clients served at a premium level. Today's pages read as a plain template (white cards in rows, bare icons, empty half-columns, nothing that shows how we build systems); make it visually rich and technically credible: professional photography, custom inline-SVG architecture diagrams, illustrations and icons, confident typography and layered sections. Keep the stack and everything the site already does: Vite + React + TypeScript + react-router, plain CSS with the design-token theme, system fonts only, every page prerendered to its own HTML file with its own title, meta description, Open Graph tags and canonical link, the hydrated training filter, Menu button and contact form, and no backend, analytics, third-party scripts or external CDNs. Existing acceptance tests keep passing except where this task changes that behavior (listed below).
